info.name: Leave Booking System API Tests
info.description:
Comprehensive API testing for COMP60047 Enterprise Application Development.
Covers all 26 endpoints with valid data (per role), invalid data, and edge cases.

Run folders in order: 1. Auth Setup → 2. Staff Management → 3. Leave Requests Commands → 4. Leave Requests Queries & Search → 5. Leave Allowances → 6. Security & Error Handling

Total: ~95 requests covering happy paths, RBAC (403), validation (400), not-found (404), state-machine conflicts (409), auth (401), rate limiting (429), and security headers.

item.name: 1. Auth — Setup & Login
item.description:
Register users, login to obtain JWT tokens, test auth endpoints.
Registers 5 users: Admin, 2 Managers (Lucy Reed, Dan Thompson), 2 Staff (Raf Ahmed, Phil James).
Self-registered users get STAFF role regardless of request (except admin callers).
Each registration also creates a skeleton staff record (PENDING_SETUP).

exec: pm.test('Clean error message mentions already exists', function() { var res = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(res.message).to.include('already exists'); });
pm.test('Contains validation error info', function() { var res = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(res.errors || res.message).to.not.be.undefined; });

item.name: Find User by Email — as Admin
Find User by Email — as Staff (expect 403)

exec: pm.test('Staff cannot find users — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Clean error message', function() { var res = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(res.message).to.include('No user found'); });

item.name: Change Password — Reset Staff2 back to original
2. Staff Management
item.description:
Admin creates, searches, and updates staff records. Tests RBAC, PENDING_SETUP flow, unified PATCH, and Firebase coordination.
POST /staff creates Firebase user + staff record. PATCH /staff/{id} routes to department/placement/status/role updates based on which fields are present.

item.name: Create Staff — Raf Ahmed (Networks, under Lucy, FULL_TIME)
Create Staff — Phil James (Digital, under Dan, PART_TIME)

exec: pm.test('Clean error message mentions already exists', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('already exists'); });
pm.test('Staff cannot create staff — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Staff cannot list all — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('All results are Networks dept', function() { pm.response.json().forEach(function(s) { pm.expect(s.department).to.equal('Networks'); }); });
pm.test('All results are PENDING_SETUP', function() { pm.response.json().forEach(function(s) { pm.expect(s.employmentStatus).to.equal('PENDING_SETUP'); }); });
pm.test('Correct staff member', function() { var res = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(res.firstName).to.equal('Raf'); pm.expect(res.employmentStatus).to.equal('PENDING_SETUP'); });

item.name: PATCH /staff/{id} — Move Raf back to Networks
PATCH /staff/{id} — Update Role to MANAGER (Firebase claim)
PATCH /staff/{id} — Reset Role back to STAFF
PATCH /staff/{id} — Update All Fields At Once

exec: pm.test('Staff cannot update staff — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: 3. Leave Requests — Commands
item.description:
Submit, approve, reject, cancel leave requests.
Tests state machine transitions (PENDING → APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED),
ownership checks (only owner can cancel, only assigned manager can approve/reject),
and domain validation (dates, leave types).

item.name: Submit Leave Request — Raf (5 days holiday)

exec: pm.test('Has reason', function() { pm.expect(res.reason).to.equal('Family holiday to Portugal'); });
pm.test('End before start returns 400', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Mentions valid leave types', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('leave type'); });

item.name: Approve — as Assigned Manager (Lucy approves Raf's request)

exec: pm.test('DecisionReason stored', function() { pm.expect(res.decisionReason).to.equal('Approved, enjoy your holiday!'); });

item.name: Approve — Wrong Manager (Dan tries to approve Lucy's team, expect 403)

exec: pm.test('Wrong manager cannot approve — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Cancel Approved — Raf cancels own approved request

exec: pm.test('DecisionReason stored', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.json().decisionReason).to.equal('Team is short-staffed that week'); });

item.name: Cancel from PENDING — Raf cancels own pending request

exec: pm.test('Cancel from PENDING returns 200', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Cannot cancel others request — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: 4. Leave Requests — Queries & Search
item.description:
GET endpoints (unfiltered reads) and POST search endpoints (filtered queries via JSON body).
GET returns all records for the user's scope. POST search requires at least one filter — empty body returns 400.
This follows the enterprise POST search pattern (Elasticsearch, Stripe).

item.name: GET /my — as Staff (Raf views own requests)
GET /team — as Manager (Lucy views her team's requests)

exec: pm.test('Staff cannot view team requests — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Manager cannot view all — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

pm.test('Has all expected fields', function() { var res = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(res.staffMemberId).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(res.managerId).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(res.leaveType).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(res.status).to.not.be.undefined; });
pm.test('All results are CANCELLED', function() { pm.response.json().forEach(function(r) { pm.expect(r.status).to.equal('CANCELLED'); }); });
pm.test('All results are REJECTED', function() { pm.response.json().forEach(function(r) { pm.expect(r.status).to.equal('REJECTED'); }); });
pm.test('Staff cannot search team — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Empty team search returns 400', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('All results for correct staff member', function() { var uid = pm.globals.get('staff1_uid'); pm.response.json().forEach(function(r) { pm.expect(r.staffMemberId).to.equal(uid); }); });
pm.test('All results for correct manager', function() { var uid = pm.globals.get('manager1_uid'); pm.response.json().forEach(function(r) { pm.expect(r.managerId).to.equal(uid); }); });
pm.test('All results are REJECTED', function() { pm.response.json().forEach(function(r) { pm.expect(r.status).to.equal('REJECTED'); }); });
pm.test('All results are CANCELLED', function() { pm.response.json().forEach(function(r) { pm.expect(r.status).to.equal('CANCELLED'); }); });
pm.test('Staff cannot search all — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: 5. Leave Allowances
item.description:
View and amend leave balances.
Allowances are auto-created when staff is activated (PENDING_SETUP → ACTIVE).
Default entitlement is 25 days unless overridden in POST /staff.

item.name: GET /my — as Staff (Raf views own allowance)
GET /staff/{id} — Manager views team member's allowance

exec: pm.test('Staff cannot view all allowances — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('All results are Networks dept', function() { pm.response.json().forEach(function(a) { pm.expect(a.department).to.equal('Networks'); }); });
pm.test('Staff cannot amend entitlement — 403', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: 6. Security & Error Handling
item.description: Cross-cutting security tests: rate limiting (Bucket4j), security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Cache-Control), and invalid token rejection.

exec: pm.test('Server header obfuscated', function() { var s = pm.response.headers.get('Server'); pm.expect(s).to.satisfy(function(v) { return !v || v === ''; }); });
